vb_textbox.text: My advice is to watch carefully which colour gnome out of each pair gets the most mushrooms and choose that for the next pair. It takes a while. Don't be disheartened if you got a lowish number lie 3, after all to choose the other gnome might have been a 0.  Watch out if a pattern emerges. Ignore the basket colour, they makes no sense. Just wait for the pattern to appear as to which gnome gets the higher number.
